title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Quiet River Systems hosts databases for research labs. The platform team keeps four hundred PostgreSQL clusters patched, backed up and boring.

You bring

  • Go or Rust in production
  • Kubernetes operators
  • A habit of writing things down

title: Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Lantern Freight moves refrigerated goods across the Baltic. You will build the weekly margin report in SQL and dbt, and sit with the dispatchers until the numbers match what they see on the dock.

Two years with a warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake.

title: Support Engineer
descriptionHtml: Answer the labs when a restore is slow, find out why, and write the runbook so the next answer is shorter. Shifts follow European working hours; nobody is paged at night. PostgreSQL knowledge matters more than the ticket tool you used before.
